title: 第4章 当向导吃穿住免费还有工资拿-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙本想宽慰离颂几句。

    毕竟听谢尘无说，离颂今年也才只有二十四岁，对秦夙来说，也是个很年轻的小伙子了。

    【那个……】

    输入两个字，又觉得说什么都不对，赶紧再用意识控制着，删掉了。

    对话界面却跳出来离颂发来的一条消息。

    【可以麻烦你代替她，再叫我一声哥哥吗？】

    秦夙心里狠狠扎了一下。

    明知道这是离颂极度破碎之下，甚至可能是悲伤导致精神混乱之下，毫无道理的要求。

    同情心还是占了上风。

    【哥哥。】

    她意念操作发送。

    过了足足有三四分钟那么久。

    离颂回了两个字，【感谢。】

    “……”秦夙无言以对。

    时间也不早了，她虽然用着萧岑的身体，但不能困在与她相关的情绪里。

    去小浴室冲个澡，吹干头发，钻进被子。

    “拿到第二条命的第一觉！”秦夙闭上眼睛扬起笑容，“晚安~”

    但是换了个陌生的世界，换了房间，换了床。

    想美美睡一觉太难了。

    后半夜，秦夙翻来覆去之间，手无意识的往旁边一伸，似乎碰到个温热的东西。

    那温度和触感，都像极了人的皮肤。

    她瞬间惊醒，小夜灯还亮着昏黄光，眼前却空无一物。

    但余光里，一缕黑金色的烟雾正迅速淡去，像是被人仓惶收回的……精神力吗？

    隐约之中，她好像还听到了很轻微的一声铃铛发出的“当啷”声？

    “谁？！”她猛地坐起来，大声呵斥，“谁在我房间里！你给我出来！”

    回答她的，只有一片寂静。

    以及窗外树枝摇曳所投下的影子。

    秦夙再摸摸床边明显塌陷下去，尚未回弹平整的一块位置。

    温热！刚才的确有人坐在这里！
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Su originally wanted to say a few words of comfort.

After all, according to Xie Chenwu, Li Song is only twenty-four years old this year. To Qin Su, he is also a very young man.

【That...】

After entering two words, I felt that nothing was right, so I quickly used my consciousness to control it and deleted it.

A message from Li Song popped up on the dialogue interface.

【Can you please replace her and call me brother again?】

Qin Su was heartbroken.

Knowing clearly that this was an unreasonable request made by Li Song when she was extremely broken, or even mentally confused due to grief.

Compassion still prevails.

【elder brother.】

She sent it with her thoughts.

A full three or four minutes passed.

Li Song replied with two words, [Thank you.】

"..." Qin Su was speechless.

It was getting late. Although she was using Xiao Cen's body, she couldn't be trapped in the emotions related to her.

Go to the small bathroom to take a shower, blow dry your hair, and get under the quilt.

"The first sleep after getting a second life!" Qin Su closed his eyes and raised a smile, "Good night~"

But it’s a different world, a different room, a different bed.

It’s so hard to get a good night’s sleep.

In the latter half of the night, while Qin Su was tossing and turning, his hand unconsciously stretched out to the side and seemed to touch something warm.

The temperature and touch are very much like human skin.

She woke up instantly, the night light was still glowing dimly, but there was nothing in front of her.

But in the peripheral vision, a wisp of black-gold smoke was quickly fading away, as if someone had hastily withdrawn... spiritual power?

Faintly, she seemed to hear a very slight "clang" sound from a bell?

"Who?!" She sat up suddenly and yelled, "Who is in my room! Come out!"

There was only silence in answer to her.

And the shadows cast by the swaying branches outside the window.

Qin Su touched the area next to the bed that had obviously collapsed and had not yet rebounded flat.

Warm!There was indeed someone sitting here just now!
